body:
Hi Thulile,

My pleasure!

We have designed the reward-based system to recognize varying levels of participation, encouraging consistent involvement while allowing for some flexibility with missed survey instances. Participants have a clear pathway to achieve the Hero badge without requiring perfect completion.

Below is how we have allocated points for each module:

Survey & Module Points per Completion Total Possible Points
mHealth Readiness Survey
Intro/Consent 5 points 5 points
Network Coverage 5 points 15 points (3 instances)
Smartphone and Cellphone Number 5 points 5 points
Airtime and Data Use 5 points 15 points (3 instances)
Phone Sharing 5 points 5 points
Internet and App Use 5 points 5 points
mHealth Readiness 5 points 5 points
Mental Health Survey
Intro/Consent 5 points 5 points
Patient Health Questionnaire-2 (PHQ-2) 3 points 36 points (12 instances)
Generalized Anxiety Disorder-2 (GAD-2) 3 points 36 points (12 instances)
Perceived Stress Scale-4 (PSS-4) 5 points 30 points (6 instances)
Primary Care PTSD Screen for DSM-5 (PC-PTSD-5) 5 points 5 points
Alcohol Use Disorders Identification Test (AUDIT-C) 5 points 30 points (6 instances)
Travel Surveys
Intro/Consent 5 points 5 points
Daily Travel Survey 2 points 60 points (30 instances)
Additionally, here are the badge thresholds:

Badge Score Required
Adventurer 35 points
Determined 80 points
Achiever 150 points
Conqueror 200 points
Champion 240 points
Super Hero 250 points or more
Please let me know if you have any questions or if you need any adjustments.

Best,
Sara
